name: Walk continuously for ten minutes
short_description: Walk continuously for ten minutes once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can walk continuously for ten minutes in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Walk continuously for ten minutes means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Walk continuously for ten minutes in a fresh real-life scenario.
